attBesluta.text: Good sounding cymbals and the sticks are a nice touch as well
Love the hi-hat and ride cymbal sounds. Hi-hat closing with the foot gives a nice, clean 'chick'.

Muy satisfecho con la compra. El juego de llaves de vaso de impacto llegó antes de lo esperado y perfectamente embalado. La calidad me ha sorprendido para bien. Se ven resistentes, bien fabricadas y cumplen perfectamente con lo que esperaba. El juego de 8 piezas es muy práctico para tener diferentes medidas disponibles. Buena relación calidad-precio y entrega rápida. Estoy muy contento con la compra y volvería a comprar en VEVOR.

I bought 2 other ones for my build, next time I would make sure its together. The only thing I would like for them to reconsider is stalling taps to secure them. Had to come up with my idea.
love my cooler same as getting but a fraction of cost i have a lawn care business and it will hold ice 2 days sitting in direct sunlight
Great! This is exactly what I want in a cooler! Lots of room for punk rock stickers and it has a beer opener!
Great cooler, just as good as the big name brands..

Absolutely love this cooler! Holds ice well and the ice pack divider comes in handy. We live in the south so it’s extremely hot right now, we load this cooler up in the bed of the truck before heading to get groceries and put our cold stuff in there, it stays cold without ice. The wire basket is great for those items that you don’t want in the ice or want to keep from moving around.

Purchased this for my fiancé. His cooler stays with him at all times. It keeps drinks cold. It’s been over 100° every day and he ices it once a day the basket is an added Plus. My only complaint is that it only comes in white. For a working man, This color is not ideal. Within the first few days of having his cooler, He had several others at work order as well. I should get a commission lol
Decent cooler. Very large and heavy. Has a lot of room.
